responsibility: Performs hard-register assignment for IRA allocnos. It implements the graph-coloring allocator used when conflicts are available, including allocno ordering, colorability/spill decisions, profitable-hard-register forests, copy/thread-based preference updates, and spill-cost comparisons used by reload, and also provides the simpler live-range-only fast allocator used in low-optimization mode. The file consumes allocnos, conflicts, hard-register cost vectors, and copy information and produces final allocno hard-register assignments or spill decisions.
